title: Code-lane branch push with merge-request push options in sync
goal: kbgit.py sync --push routes by lane with kblane.py: a content-only range pushes to main as today; a range with a code-lane commit pushes code/<id> with the four push options, retries without them when the output says 'the receiving end does not support push options' and prints the instruction, and exits 0 once the branch is pushed; sync --dry-run names the lane and the branch; TestCodeLaneSync in _tools/test_sync.py covers content, code, mixed, and push options advertised and not
